column4: Maine Department of Environmental Protection; Air Quality; Need either a Minor Source License or a Major Source License. Minor sources emit less than the following: 50 tons per year of VOC for facilities within the Ozone Transport Region, 10 tons per year of single Hazardous Air Pollutant, 25 tons per year of all Hazardous Air Pollutants combined, 100 tons per year of any other regulated pollutant. Major sources emit one or more of the following: 50 tons per year of VOC for facilities within the Ozone Transport Region, 10 tons per year of single Hazardous Air Pollutant, 25 tons per year of all Hazardous Air Pollutants combined, 100 tons per year of any other regulated pollutant

New Jersey Department of Environmental Protection (NJDEP)
Needs permits in accordance with NJAC 7:27-8 if rated heat input is 1,000,000 BTU/hr or greater
For minor facilities, GP-005A for distillate fuels, GP-005B for gaseous fuels 
For major facilities, GOP-003 w maximum rated heat input of less than or equal to 30 MMBTU/hr, and a GOP-004 for gaseous fuels
GP-005 was a permit that existed, since displaced by GP-005A and GP-OO5B but still can run before expiration
